thread:
Anya: Heads-up — got a pile of customer asks this morning re: Optimize toolkit. They want batching defaults, cache TTLs exposed, quantization recs, and eval-triggered alerts. Can we decide Q2 priority?
Mohit: Quick scoring: impact x effort — batching (high impact, mid effort), quant (high impact, high risk), eval-alerts (mid impact, low effort).
Carmen: +1. Sales needs a clear rollout plan they can present to pilot customers. Suggested gates: canary 1% -> 10% -> 100%. Also need SLOs and explicit rollback criteria.
Kyle: For quant, we need model-fidelity tests. We'll run int8 + AWQ on the three pilot customer models and compare key metrics. If metric delta > threshold, we block.
Lauren: What's the threshold? Sales wants max 2% relative drop on each customer's core metric. Ops wants latency guardrails too.
Mohit: Proposed acceptance checklist (sketch):
  - latency p95 <= baseline * 1.20
  - eval-metric drop <= 2% relative (per-model, per-customer)
  - cost/tok improvement or neutral (for quant/batching targets)
  - no increase in error-rate or hallucination signals above historical baseline
Anya: Can someone turn that into a short gating doc we can share with pilots?
Carmen: I'll draft. Quick concrete rollout plan below: 
```
Canary stage: 1% traffic for 48h -> monitor p95, cost delta, eval metric.
Ramp stage: 10% for 72h -> run targeted A/B evals (prompt sets).
Full stage: 100% after two successful ramps with no blocks.
Block conditions: p95 > baseline*1.25 OR eval-metric_drop > 2% OR error-rate spike > 3x baseline.
Fallback: automatic route to previous model variant + notify oncall.
```
Kyle: Batching defaults proposal: GPU baseline batch_size=32, adaptive down to 8 for latency-sensitive routes. CPU fallback batch_size=4. Adaptive policy: target_latency_ms=150, max_batch_wait_ms=20.
Kyle: KV/prefix cache defaults: TTL=30s, max_entries=250k; expose route-level knobs to tune TTL and enable/disable.
Lauren: Ops asks for per-route opt-out: add config flag `allow_batching=false` and `allow_quantization=false` at route-level. Also require a per-tenant audit log for any quantized runs.
Mohit: Telemetry + alerts: need per-route cost delta, token histograms, p95/p50 latency, eval-triggered alert counts. Eval-alert rule draft: if eval-alert > 5 failing prompts in rolling 24h -> page oncall and open ticket.
ops-bot: deploy checklist created: https://go/internal/opt-toolkit/deploy-checks (auto-generated)
Anya: Next steps (owners): Carmen -> acceptance doc + pilot playbook (EOD tomorrow). Kyle -> quant microbench on 3 pilot models (results by Friday). Mohit -> telemetry dashboard + alert rules (prototype by Tuesday). Lauren -> API opt-out flags + audit log (PR by next week).
Carmen: I'll include example prompt suites per customer and a minimal eval harness to run during canary.
Kyle: Will post microbench numbers in #eng-ml and link raw logs. Expecting to test int8 + AWQ variants.
Mohit: I'll add dashboard widgets: cost delta, tokens/sec, latency p95, eval pass rate; and wire up Grafana alerts to PagerDuty.
Lauren: Thanks all. If no objections, let's lock this as Q2 priority and communicate to sales/pilot customers. :thumbsup:
Anya: No objections from me. Carmen — ping when draft is up and we'll loop legal if we need NDA clarifications for pilot data.
Carmen: Will do.
